_meta.purpose: Seed cache of model/year knowledge so the system does not re-research the same bike every hour.
_meta.refreshPolicy: Refreshed on MODEL_CACHE_TTL_HOURS (default 336h = 14 days). Only the stale entry is refreshed, not the whole file.
_meta.valueDisclaimer: All value ranges are ESTIMATES for private-party sales in Central Texas in good condition. They are starting points for comparison, not appraisals.

yamaha_r3.label: Yamaha YZF-R3

generations.2015-2018: First gen. Conventional forks, taller bars, softer suspension.
generations.2019-present: Second gen. 37mm USD forks, lower clip-ons, sharper fairing, revised dash.

knownIssues: Early 2015 units were subject to recall campaigns covering the clutch pressure plate and fuel pump. Verify the VIN was remedied.
OEM Michelin Pilot Street tires are widely considered the weak point and are often replaced early.
Soft stock suspension, especially the rear shock, on first-gen bikes.
Stator/regulator failures reported occasionally on high-mileage first-gen bikes.
maintenance: Valve clearance inspection interval is long (roughly 26,600 mi) but expensive if deferred.
Chain and sprockets typically need replacement around 15k-20k mi.
yamaha_r3.mileageAdjustment: Below 8k miles tends to sit at the upper end; above 20k miles drops toward the low end.
yamaha_r3.resaleNotes: Strong beginner-bike demand keeps resale healthy. Easy to sell on.
buyerChecks: Check for drop damage on bar ends, levers, and fairing edges.
Ask whether the valve check has been done if over 25k miles.

ninja_400.label: Kawasaki Ninja 400

generations.2018-2023: Trellis frame, lighter than the R3, assist/slipper clutch standard.

knownIssues: Budget rear shock; many riders replace or revalve it.
Isolated reports of gear position sensor faults.
Very popular with new riders, so a higher proportion of examples have been dropped.
ninja_400.mileageAdjustment: Under 6k miles commands a premium. Over 20k drops meaningfully.
ninja_400.resaleNotes: Among the strongest resale values in the small-sport class.
buyerChecks: Inspect for drop damage given the beginner-heavy ownership.
Confirm the slipper clutch engages smoothly.
Check for a replaced or leaking rear shock.

ninja_500.label: Kawasaki Ninja 500

generations.2024-present: Replaced the Ninja 400. Larger displacement, similar chassis.

knownIssues: Too new for a reliable long-term fault record.
Minimal used supply, so comparables are thin.
maintenance: Still within typical warranty period for most examples.
ninja_500.mileageAdjustment: Almost all examples are low mileage; condition and warranty matter more than miles.
ninja_500.resaleNotes: Expected to track the Ninja 400's strong resale once supply builds.
buyerChecks: Verify first service was performed on schedule.
ninja_500.budgetNote: Rarely available under $4,100. Expect few or no matches at this budget.

aprilia_rs457.label: Aprilia RS 457

generations.2024-present: Aluminium twin-spar frame, ride modes, traction control.

knownIssues: Too new for a reliable long-term fault record.
Dealer network and parts availability are thinner than the Japanese brands, which can mean longer waits on parts.
maintenance: Service costs tend to run above the Japanese equivalents.
aprilia_rs457.mileageAdjustment: Nearly all examples are low mileage; warranty status dominates value.
buyerChecks: Ask where it has been serviced and how far the nearest dealer is.
aprilia_rs457.budgetNote: Rarely available under $4,100. Expect few or no matches at this budget.

cfmoto_450ss.label: CFMoto 450SS

generations.2023-present: 270-degree crank, aggressive styling, strong value proposition new.

knownIssues: Too new for a long-term fault record.
Dealer network is sparse in parts of Texas; parts lead times can be longer.
Brand resale is weaker than the Japanese equivalents.
maintenance: Follow CFMoto's break-in and first service.
Confirm a servicing dealer exists within reasonable range before buying.
cfmoto_450ss.mileageAdjustment: Condition and warranty dominate; mileage is usually low across the board.
cfmoto_450ss.resaleNotes: Weakest resale of the five. Buy on price, not on expected resale value.
buyerChecks: Locate the nearest servicing dealer first.
Confirm warranty status and that service was done on schedule.
cfmoto_450ss.budgetNote: Rarely available under $4,100. Expect few or no matches at this budget.
